last_comments.DOYENI: Began well, ridden along to hold rail 3L from leader.       Dropped back slightly back stretch, edged forward around    home turn, took inside run in straight and finished off     strongly.
last_comments.PRAWN BABA: Jumped well, sharing early pace before settling in box      seat. Threw out challenge at turn in but joined by several  rivals 200m and raced in restricted room final stages. Not  fully tested.
last_comments.ROCKETEER: Away well, racing one-out 3L from leader. Closed in around  home turn, looked winner when hit front 250m, bumped and    unbalanced 100m, overtaken final strides.
last_comments.DINOZZO: Raced behind midfield early stages before edging closer     along rail back stretch. Shifted out at turn in to          challenge but blocked several times when improving and not  fully tested.
last_comments.GENERAL SHERMAN: Began awkwardly, then crowded and before settling on rail   5L from leader. Turned in behind wall of horses, got split  350m before forcing way between horses to win close home.
last_comments.RENAISSANCE ART: Raced one-out ahead of midfield mostly to straight when put under pressure, making some progress to 200m before turning one-paced.
last_comments.HAPPILABABY: Outpaced, dropping to rear along fence. Last turning for    home and little response when put under pressure in         straight. Lost right hind plate near 450m.
last_comments.ANDOYAS: Slow to move, outpaced, dropping to last pair but away from fence. Remained at rear to straight where one-paced.
last_comments.GREEN DISPATCH: Hard ridden from an outside draw to lead, crossing to fence 1700m. Started to race keenly when challenged up front      1400m, setting hot pace to 200m when emptied.
last_comments.FAITHFUL TRINITY: Cruised forward early and settled just forward of midfield. Made no impression in the straight, and was eased out late.
last_comments.IRON BOY: Dropped back from the wide draw to sit last. Stayed on      solidly in the straight, without threatening.
last_comments.REGENCY BO BO: Pushed forward early and settled 2nd/3rd, 1 off the fence.  Battled on solidly in the straight, and just lost a place   in the last 50m.
last_comments.COBY BOY: Cruised forward early to settle midfield, 3 wide with       limited cover. Started his run before the turn, and ran     strongly in the straight. Nosed in front at the 200m, and   had enough in the tank to hold on late.
last_comments.GRANITE BELT: Eased back early to sit around midfield, on the fence.      Ridden for luck at the top of the straight, and got a clear passage in the straight. Ran solidly late and only peaked   near the line.
last_comments.LUCKY GUY: Cruised forward early and settle just behind midfield. Off  heels at 1100m. Ran solidly early in the straight, before   taking the bit between his teeth and finishing last 200m    strongly. Was gaining on the winner at the finish.
last_comments.PRESIDENTPARAMOUNT: Pressed forward from the wide draw to sit 2nd/3rd, but      stuck 3 wide with no cover. Nothing left in the straight,   and dropped back quickly from the 250m.
last_comments.STARLIT KNIGHT: Bumped and unbalanced on jumping before settling midfield,  1 off the fence. Never responded in the straight, and went  to the line meekly under minimal urging.
last_comments.GIANT TURTLE: Dropped back early from the wide draw to settle 2nd last.   At the back of the pack turning for home, but ran solidly   in the straight and gaining momentum late.
last_comments.MAGIC AGILITY: Slowly away, and settled towards the rear of the field.     Never competitive. Unacceptable performance.
last_comments.ALCAZAR: Got head up early when being steadied back from the wide    draw. Settled worse than midfield, wide with limited cover. Dropped out quickly in the straight. Unacceptable           performance.
last_comments.FLYING MONKEY: Pushed forward from the inside draw to be early leader,     before being crossed at 1000m, and settling 3rd/4th.        Hampered when missing a run at 200m, and went to the line 1 paced late.
last_comments.CREME BRULEE: Jumped cleanly, eased to settle well back & deep, ridden    from 650m, last 500m, never a threat.
last_comments.HELENE CHARISMA: Taken in for cover soon after start, dropping one-out       towards rear. Taken wide in straight and pressed forward    but hung in badly and not fully tested. Racing manners      unacceptable.
last_comments.SIR REDALOT: Pressed forward early to eventually take the lead. Peaked   on his run at the 200m, and not pushed hard to the line     from that point. Jockey questioned.
last_comments.GENEROUS HEART: Crossed to a 3-wide spot behind midfield, swung widest into straight but couldn't pick up pace on his AWT debut.
last_comments.URBAN CHIC: Pushed and slotted into midfield, sat 3-1/4L behind along   the rail, lost ground rounding turn, did not threaten.
last_comments.PEACE COMBINATION: Awkwardly away, bumped soon after, settled beyond midfield  4 deep, niggled 750m, ridden 480m, bumped 250m, stayed on   well.
last_comments.PERFECT CHOICE: Dropped back to near the rear, ran on steadily when driven  400M, had no clear run final 100M and could have been       closer.
last_comments.BRAVE KNIGHT: Bumped soon after start, outpaced early, settled near rear  on outside rail, clicked up 550m, found line nicely late.
last_comments.ENCHANTED FEELING: Away on terms, eased to midfield spot 6 deep, ridden 450m,  one-paced to line.
last_comments.ART OF RAW: Pushed and settled to race in midfield, 3-3/4L behind 2     wide, pushed from home turn, found nothing.
last_comments.SUPER WISE: Settled to race in front of midfield, sat 2-1/2L off 2      wide, ran on well to take 3rd.
last_comments.WAYFOONG VINNIE: Taken back and raced in behind midfield, 4-3/4L behind 3    wide, closed off nicely to take 2nd.
last_comments.E-SUPER: Sent forward and led by 3/4L in a 2 wide position, weakened gradually passing 200M.
last_comments.SUNNY WIN: Raced in midfield, 3-3/4L behind 2 wide making the first    turn, finished off strongly inside 150M to score.
last_comments.KING MORTAR: Pushed and raced inside the lead along the rail, sat 3/4L   off, ran on but couldn't' hold off the others inside final  50M.
last_comments.ELITE SPIRIT: Pushed and settled in one-off one-back position, sat 1L     off, flattened passing 250M.
last_comments.OPEN HOUSE: Crowded start and remained at the rear throughout, 6-3/4L   behind 3 wide with cover, never a factor.
last_comments.KHAKI: Rolled forward and raced in box-seat, sat 2-1/4L off,       remained one paced in the straight.
last_comments.SILLY BUDDIES: Eased and raced towards the rear, 5-1/2L behind 2 wide,     made good ground inside 250M and closed off strongly.
last_comments.HAPPY COOPERATION: Strode forward to race just outside leader, gained narrow   lead inside 350M, soon pressed by eventual winner, fought   on to 100M, no extra and weakened to 5th late.
last_comments.MR RIGHT: Positively ridden from the beginning, crossed to the lead   700M, outsprinted by rivals passing 300M, weakened          noticeably final stages.
last_comments.GOLDEN KID: Raced at the rear, 6-3/4L behind along the rail, not        competitive.
last_comments.PAKISTAN BABY: Restrained in a 2-wide spot in mid-division, held up        300M-150M behind leaders, let down well when clear and went 3rd before line. Unlucky.
last_comments.ARIZONA BLIZZARD: Given a waiting ride 5Ls off the pace, closed off strongly  down outside, held by diminishing neck.
last_comments.HARBOUR ALERT: Heavily restrained behind the pace, raced keenly middle     stages, improved to outside leader  250M, knuckled down     with determination, gained upper hand 100M, held sway to    the line fending off a late challenge.
last_comments.MOST BEAUTIFUL: Never far off the pace but caught wide no cover from draw   12, within striking distance passing 350M but failed to     make ground on leaders, well held over final 150M.
last_comments.BORNTOACHIEVE: Quickly crossed to the rail, always prominent, difficult to settle when crossed by rival 700M, couldn't find another    gear turning in, no clear run final 100M but already out of contention.
last_comments.HAPPY SURVEYS: Sluggish away, well off the pace early stages, last of 12   turning in but couldn't kick away, never likely.
last_comments.GRACE HEART: Speed to lead, headed 1020m & settled close 2nd 1 off,      nudged along 500m to press lead, driven ahead turning in,   kicked clear centre track.
last_comments.AGIAAL: Taken back at start and settled at tail, tried to improve   passing 500M, made some ground after 150, finished fairly.
last_comments.SUPER FORM: Broke well, soon taken back to sit midfield on rail, shaken up 300m, ran on for solid headway.
last_comments.OTOUTO: Broke ok & raced 3 wide with cover midfield until exposed   800m, niggled 550m, driven wide home turn, found nil &      tapered.
last_comments.PLANET STAR: Taken back to rail near rear, progress on turn & driven     300m, ran on to nick 2nd late.
last_comments.STARLIGHT: Restrained at start to rail at tail, niggled 400m, driven   300m & shifted out, kept on well to take 3rd late.
last_comments.SIGHT SEEING: Started with others, midfield 3 deep when overraced 1100m & shuffled to back of mid rank 1 off with cover, on & off     bridle, hard-ridden 420m, wide in stretch, stayed on for    late gains.
last_comments.REGENCY HONEY: Fast break, bustled to lead on rail 1020m, pressed &        niggled final turn & headed into stretch, outkicked &       plugged on evenly until emptied & swamped 50m.
last_comments.SKY TREASURE: Pushed to midfield initially but wide no cover & overraced  1100m, restrained to near rear 3 wide with cover, niggled   along, under pump 500m, driven widest in run, struggled.
last_comments.SCARBOROUGH FAIR: Broke with others, raced midfield 1 off with cover,         snatched off heels 780m, bustled 500m, driven centre track, plugged on evenly.
last_comments.OUR HONOUR: Taken back at break to last pair 1 off, niggled 650m,       driven turning in, one-paced in tame effort.
last_comments.FOREVER FUN: Broke well, bustled to sit 1 back on rail, niggled 550m,    under pump in 4th 450m, weakened out in run home.
last_comments.FORTUNE BO BO: Away fairly, niggled early, assumed front 1080m & down to   rail, joined & headed narrowly 750m, held together until    350m, reclaimed lead soon after, clearly headed 170m,       fought back & got bob.
last_comments.PEACE N PROSPERITY: Jumped quickly, ridden through to be up near the speed,     eased to settle in box seat on inside, clicked up 370m,     stuck to inside, almost on terms 200m, boxed on.
last_comments.TORNEY: Pushed after start and shifted in to settle in midfield,    commenced to improve passing 450M, fought hard in the       straight and finished fairly.
last_comments.LUCKY DOUBLE EIGHT: Away well, steadied towards the rear early, stuck 3 deep    until 800m, settled 2nd last 1 off, outpaced and ridden     500m, back to inside on straightening, made no impression.
last_comments.AMAZING ALWAYS: Soon after start became unbalanced, settled behind          midfield, commence to improve passing 500M, shifted out for clear running in early straight, worked home solidly.
last_comments.MY BLESSING: Pushed forward, sat 2 wide, pace good, ran on until 100M    flattened.
last_comments.CLEVER SPIRIT: Jumped nicely, pushed to take lead and passing 1100M        drifted back to box seat, asked effort passing 400M, in the early straight was bumped and became unbalanced, failed to  run on.
last_comments.POLYMER LUCK: Pushed to settle outside the leader after start, drifted    back to front of midfield after 800M, taken out to improve  at home turn, finished satisfactorily.
last_comments.GO GO WIN: Pushed forward to take rail and lead at good pace, made all.
last_comments.LOADED: Just fair to begin, hampered soon after start, settled      beyond midfield 1 off, keen at times, niggled 600m, lost    position 450m, never a threat.
last_comments.WORKS OF ART: Settled in box seat, pace good, closed off well for 2nd.
last_comments.WAH MAY BABY: Behind midfield, 2 wide, pace good, bumped 300M, ran on ok  in straight.
last_comments.GOAL FOR GOLD: Pushed to hold the rail in midfield, pace good, blocked     whole straight, never tested.
last_comments.FORMULA GALORE: Eased to sit in midfield, 2 wide, pace good, just held      ground in straight.
last_comments.DARING HEART: At rear, shortly after the start became very unbalanced in  its action and attempted to buck for some distance, pace    good, never improved.
last_comments.GOOD METHOD: Hard ridden forward, sat outside the leader, pace good, out of fuel 200M.
last_comments.FINE WITH ME: Eased back, took rail, on heels early, pace good,           progressed steadily 250M for 3rd.
last_comments.BEST EFFORT: Slow away, took rail at rear, on heels early, pace good,    made steady ground 200M.
last_comments.G-ONE UNION: Eased at start, took rail, checked early, pace good, ran on fairly in straight.
last_comments.TRENDY WIN: Steadied to obtain cover after start, soon was crowed for   room and became unbalanced, settle behind midfield, in      early straight was held up for clear running until passing  250M, one-paced.
last_comments.GOOD CHOICE: Taken back at start, settled at rear, urged for speed in    early straight, quickened passing final 100M, came home     strongly.
last_comments.LITTLE FANTASY: Jumped well, travelled wide and without cover until 800M    being ridden along to settle outside the leader, in the     early straight was bumped and became unbalanced, finished   disappointing.
last_comments.SUNNY ORIENT: Settled at handy position, was hampered when held up for    clear running in early straight, not fully tested.
last_comments.DIAMOND LEGEND: Moderate start, settled at handy position, drifted back to  midfield passing 1000M, issued challenge passing 550M and   widest on straightening, fought hard entire straight.
last_comments.TOP ACT: Even break, niggled early to settle midfield on rail, off   the bit and niggled throughout, laying out towards heels    and awkwardly placed 400m, one-paced early in straight,     picked up late.
last_comments.CAREFREE LET GO: Started OK, hard ridden along to take lead passing 1100M,   shifted in on rail passing 800M, commenced to tire passing  200M.
last_comments.RACING MATE: On back foot at start, quickly into midfield spot 1 off,    pushed through to settle fore of midfield, slightly keen,   niggled 620m, driven 350m, pulled centre track, couldn't    come on.
last_comments.YOU READ MY MIND: Jumped well from a wide draw, sent forward to take the      lead, shared lead on turn, peaked near 150M, weakened       thereafter.
last_comments.CHATER LEGEND: Shifted across behind horses from widest gate, dropping to  last. Tailed field to straight, taken wide and finished off steadily.
last_comments.CLASSIC EMPEROR: Away nicely, sharing early pace before easing into box seat 1.5L from leader. Looked a chance turning for home but      found little when asked and swamped close home.
last_comments.SUPER CHIC: Restrained soon after start and shifted in for cover,       dropping one-out towards the rear. Kept on a strong hold to straight, ran on steadily to snatch minor placing.
last_comments.INVENTOR: Not pushed early, settling along rail behind midfield. Got  shuffled back turning for home, stayed on rail in straight  and ran on fairly, doing best work final stages.
last_comments.PERPETUAL JOYANCE: Jumped well, positioned 3 lengths or so back on rail, there to turn, angled out in straight and finished off well, just missed.
last_comments.GENERAL IRON: Bumped shortly after the start, raced 2 wide in 5th, same   position on turn, taken wide in straight and finished off   one-paced.
last_comments.HEALTHY LUCK: Average to begin, sent forward to race prominently,         unbalanced near 700M, saved ground on turn, showed no       response in straight and eased. (See Racing Incidents.)
last_comments.PRINCE HARMONY: Away with them, positioned 1 out 1 back, there to turn,     peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter.    (See Racing Incidents.)
last_comments.TRUMP: Taken back from a wide draw, raced 6 lengths back at rear,  carried wider near 650M, same margin back on turn, took     widest in straight and made reasonable progress.
last_comments.DOLLAR REWARD: Taken back from gate 8, raced at tail, slightly improved    along the rail on turn, unable to obtain clear running in   straight, not able to test properly.
last_comments.HO HO HORSE: Crowded out start, raced 5 lengths or so back at rear,      difficult to settle near 650M, 2 wide on turn, no clear     running until final 100M, made good progress late to make   frame.
last_comments.SUNNY DRAGON: Slightly slow out, positioned 4 lengths or so back on rail, got its head up when awkwardly placed on heels near 700M,   slightly improved on turn, no daylight early in straight,   finished off well when clear final 150M to score narrowly.
last_comments.MASTER VIKING: Moderately away from a tricky draw, unable to slot in       early, sent forward near 700M to race outside the leader,   kept on well in straight, but couldn't hold off the first   two late.
last_comments.CHEER WIN: Among fastest to begin, pushed early but couldn't cross to  lead, eased to settle fore of midfield 3 deep & overracing, ridden 600m, came into race strongly at 250m, narrow lead   170m, just outbobbed.
last_comments.EXTREMELY FUN: Jumped well from the widest gate, raced 2 wide, 4 lengths   back in midfield, same margin back on turn, failed to close off in straight.
last_comments.MR GENUINE: Jumped nicely, not pushed, settling along rail 3L from      leader. Switched out top of straight to issue challenge but only one-paced.
last_comments.BOND ELEGANCE: Fast to begin, among leaders early, restrained to sit 2nd   outside leader until 800m when back to 3rd, clicked up      350m, crowded 200m, stuck on OK.
last_comments.GRACYDAD: Slightly slow break, trapped very wide on course, pushed on 4 deep towards the speed, took narrow lead 750m 1 off,      ridden 360m, joined shortly afterwards, weakened quickly.
last_comments.G-ONE LOVER: Broke well, eased to settle midfield but stuck 4 deep no    cover, pushed along 520m, driven hard on straightening,     kept coming, charged into 3rd on line.
last_comments.LAND GRANT: Pushed and crossed runners to take rail and led by 1L, kept on until 250M and faded gradually.
last_comments.PHOTON WILLIE: Slow to jump, settled to race in worse than midfield,       6-1/2L behind along the rail, made minor ground.
last_comments.DR LISTENING: Travelled in midfield, 4-1/2L behind 2 wide, shifted wide   on straightening, kept on but couldn't match winner's       effort inside final 100M.
last_comments.JADE FORTUNE: Settled to race in midfield, 5L behind along the rail,      improved steadily and ran on well to the line.
last_comments.SUPER LEADER: Eased and settled to race in worse than midfield, 6-1/4L    behind 2 wide, did not improve.
last_comments.OUTLAWED: Settled to race in front of midfield, sat 3L off 2 wide,    kept on and closed off nicely to score by a neck.
last_comments.LITTLE DRAGON: Raced behind midfield but wide, then covered extra ground   home turn, before dropping out in straight. Lame right hind leg.
last_comments.THUNDER STOMP: Pushed and settled to race outside the lead, sat 1L off,    kept on going but couldn't hold off the first two.
last_comments.THE SYLPH: Taken back and raced at the rear, 8-1/4L behind along the   rail, showed good dash approaching 150M to save ground.
last_comments.SPEEDY LONGWAH: Pressed forward to stay with the pace, racing wide without  cover 3L from leader. Covered extra ground home turn and    finished off one-paced.
last_comments.WISKY: Settled to race in box-seat, sat 1-1/2L off, under pressure when rounding turn, found nothing and was disappointing.
last_comments.HIGH VOLATILITY: Sent forward and stayed prominent, sat 2-1/2L off but       trapped wide and without cover, not competitive in straight.
last_comments.IMPERIAL CONCORDE: Lacked toe & bustled along to rail midfield, driven 550m,   shifted out wide into stretch, driven home for even headway.
last_comments.RED HORSE: Taken back, trapped 4 wide no cover back of midfield,       shuffled to near tail 700m, 2nd last & driven 500m, soon to last, not a factor.
last_comments.LONDON MASTER: Away on terms , pushed into handy spot, settled fore of     midfield 1 off, ridden 460m, one-paced to line.
last_comments.EVER STRONG: Good jump, natural speed to get into handy spot, settled    3rd but stayed 1 off, pulled 3 deep & ridden 500m, effort   short-lived.
last_comments.HURRICANE HUNTER: Slightly slow, eased to settled beyond midfield 1 out,      ridden 500m, took time to wind up, strong last 100m.
last_comments.SURE PEACE: Slow break and punched along to settle near rear 3 wide     with cover, advanced wide form 700m, mid rank & progressing turning in, closed centre track to 2nd late.
last_comments.NAMJONG INVINCIBLE: Awkward start & rousted to 1st turn, settled rail fore of   midfield, shifted 1 off 550m & quickened to 2nd turning in, driven to lead 250m, raced clear.
last_comments.METALLIC STAR: Jumped smartly, ridden along to take lead, kicked in early  straight and held off to win.
last_comments.SPICY KAKA: Tardy start, rolled forward to park fore of midfield 1 off  with cover, keen in backstretch, shifted 3 deep for         progress 600m, 4th & driven turning in, weakened in run     home.
last_comments.NOBLE DE LOVE: Jumped nicely, urged along and sat at box position, under   pressure in the straight, finished OK.
last_comments.THE JAZZ: Settled midfield on rail, asked for effort passing 600M,    tried hard but only one-paced.
last_comments.AMBITIOUS PINS: Crowded after start, no early speed and settled at rear,    improved at home turn, ran on and battled well in the       straight.
last_comments.HAR HAR HEART: Travelled wide without cover in midfield, out of fuel after 300M, failed to run on.
last_comments.PENZANCE: Fractious in the barrier, began only fairly, settled        midfield, never in it. Must trial.
last_comments.VIVA COUNCIL: Taken back at start, settled at tail, hung out and proved   difficult to ride, finished only fairly. Unacceptable       racing manners, rider questioned and must series trials.
last_comments.CAPE THE FAITH: Sharp start, to rail 1 back & overraced 1300m, 1.5L 2nd     680m & hard ridden 500m, 3rd turning in, tapered in run.
last_comments.UNIQUE JOYOUS: Tardy & crowded start, bustled to settle near rear 1 off,   to rail 800m, driven 550m & progress turning in, kept on    for minor headway.
last_comments.WINASWEWISH: Sluggish start, raced last pair 1 off, niggled 900m, last   &ridden 680m, hard driven turning in & switched out, stayed on under drive centre track.
last_comments.SUPER TALENT: Fast break, bustled to park 2nd 1 off, niggled 1050m &      shuffled to 1 of 1 back, 3 deep no cover 850m & under       pressure, mid rank & hard-ridden wide on turn, faded out.
last_comments.ENSURING: Crowded start, in worse than midfield, 4L behind along the  rail, found extra passing 200M, ran on well to the line.
last_comments.RED MARVEL: Broke well, hard ridden to lead on the rail but harassed by outside runner. Pulled narrowly ahead on straightening but  soon under pressure and tired passing 200.
last_comments.MCQUEEN: Jumped awkwardly, settled to race in box-seat, sat 1-3/4L   off, kept on mostly one paced to the line.
last_comments.WINNING FAITH: Caught wide early, taken across behind runners before the   turn, 6Ls off the pace and last turning in, couldn't        quicken from the rear, never involved.
last_comments.BRAVE LEGEND: Began well, dropped back to mid-division before the turn,   kept on steadily for remote 4th, no impression on first 2.
last_comments.HAIR TRIGGER: Chased leaders along the 2-path, couldn't accelerate enough passing 400M, out of contention mid-straight.
last_comments.JUMBO LUCK: Crossed to the lead passing 1000M, taken on by rivals in    the fore, quickened up strongly when asked 300M and soon    opened up an unassailable lead, coasted home final 50M.
last_comments.STAR OF JOY: Jumped fairly to be about 5th on settling, 3-wide over home turn but always within striking distance, fought on same    pace only in straight, no threat from 200M.
last_comments.SEASONS BLOOM: Jumped OK, not pushed, settling on rail towards rear.       Stayed on rail turning for home, switched out 300m to issue challenge, hit the front 100m and pulled clear.
last_comments.PEOPLE'S KNIGHT: Out quickly but restrained and taken to fence 4L from       leader. Came off fence in straight to make challenge but    only one-paced.
last_comments.JOLLY JOLLY: Broke well, hard ridden to lead but kept away from rail by  inside runner. Dropped back 1000m to take sit on leader,    boxed on gamely in straight to hold down minor placing.
last_comments.LUCKY GIRL: Hard ridden from jump to hold fence, gradually edging       forward to lead passing 1000m and slowing the pace.         Overtaken passing 350m and faded gradually.
last_comments.CALIFORNIA JOY: Out quickly, battled for early lead before settling in box  seat 2L from leader. Bumped turning for home, urged forward top of straight, hit front 350m, run down 100m, boxed on.
last_comments.MAGICAL BEAUTY: Bounced OK, not pushed, dropping to rear in one-out         position. Taken wide entering straight, given reminders     before eased down final stages when beaten.
last_comments.RODRICO: Jumped well, ridden early to go forward before settling     behind midfield in one-out position. Dropped back steadily  around turn before plodding home in the straight.
last_comments.NUCLEAR POWER: Not hurried after the jump and eased back to near the rear, 5Ls off leader at 400M, stayed on mildly for                non-threatening 3rd.
last_comments.KEEN VENTURE: Shifted across behind runners shortly after start, settling at rear but away from fence. Swung wide entering straight,  ran on gamely, doing best work final stages.
last_comments.MYTHICAL EMPEROR: Unable to cross from widest draw, caught 3 wide no cover    outside the pace, weakened rapidly passing 400M, finished   tailed out. (Unacceptable Performance.)
last_comments.LUCKY DAY: Shifted across behind runners from widest gate and last on  settling. Hard ridden from 600m to go forward but only      minor gain till running past beaten rivals in straight.
last_comments.ARM RUNDA: Began fairly, ridden along early stages trying to improve   its position but became difficult to settle making the turn at 900M, towards the rear turning in, couldn't pick up and  eased late stages.
last_comments.VICTORY BOYS: Travelled at the rear, 5L behind 2 wide, shifted widest and made good ground in straight, closed off strongly to score.
last_comments.UP AND COMING: Raced outside the lead, sat about 1L off, weakened badly    approaching 300M.
last_comments.LOTUS STRIKES BACK: Travelled in about a midfield position, 3-3/4L behind 2     wide, kept on until about 250M and then flattened.
last_comments.GORGEOUS AGAIN: Raced just in front of midfield, 2-1/2L off 2 wide, shifted out to make early move at 700M, checked at 50M but kept on  going to the line. (Rider questioned)
last_comments.WHITE MAGIC: Jumped well, tightened before first turn, then settled in   box seat behind hot pace. Switch out 4-wide top of          straight, surged forward to lead 350m, then boxed on gamely the overtaken 110m.
last_comments.MISTER MONTE: Bumped start, eased and raced at the rear, 6L behind along  the rail, under pressure near 700M, never a factor.
last_comments.GRAND HARBOUR: Hard ridden to hold forward position, eye-balling leader    from first turn to straight. Boxed on gamely under pressure in straight to 200m before tiring.
last_comments.CELESTIAL ARROW: Beaten for pace early pace then lay out approaching first   turn, dropping back towards rear. Dropped to last turning   for home, one-paced.
last_comments.TURIN PEARL: Hard ridden to share early pace, taking first turn 3-wide   before being eased back 1L passing 1000m. Swung very wide   entering straight but kept on strongly to hold down         quinella spot.
last_comments.WILLIE WAY: Jumped well, taken in for cover towards rear first turn     before switching out wide back stretch. Switched in home    turn, blocked 400m, switched out 300m, finished strongly to win eased down.
last_comments.FUNNY BUDDIES: Hard ridden to keep up in midfield, 2 wide, benefited by    the fast tempo, progressed steadily 300M to score.
last_comments.IDYLLIC WIND: Hard ridden forward, sat 2 wide, not suited by the fast     tempo, out of fuel 150M.
last_comments.DON WONGCHOY: Slow away, at back, 2-3 wide, suited by the fast tempo,     however  never improved.
last_comments.BLISS CARTEL: Eased back, took cover, 2 wide, favoured by the fast pace,  lack room 4-2, dashed well when clear.
last_comments.SEVEN LUCK: Hard ridden to hold the rail in midfield, favoured by the   fast pace, however held up most straight, ran on ok.
last_comments.ALL TOGETHER: Hard ridden forward, trapped 3-4 wide throughout, harmed by the fast pace, flattened 150M.

last_comments.GLACIER BLUE: Raced at the tail throughout, found nothing in the straight.

last_comments.ORIENTAL PROSPER: Pressed forward, racing wide without cover about 1L behind  leader. Lay out around turn but remained in contention      until weakening final 200m.
last_comments.FUN 'N' GAMES: Hard ridden forward, just off the leader 2 wide, harmed by  the fast pace, no turn of foot in straight.
last_comments.CONFUCIUS ELITE: Speed to lead under drive, headed 1130m, sat 1 back from    820m, shifted 1 off & driven 350m, plugged on evenly.
last_comments.KING OF REASON: Broke well but soon outpaced, raced rail near rear, crowded & not clear run turning in, shaken up 300m, stayed on for   minor inroads.
last_comments.HOLY MAC: Slow to begin, raced keenly near 1400m, under pressure home turn before weakening in straight.
last_comments.FORTUNE BRAVO: Jumped well and settled behind leaders, stoked up to        challenge home turn, tried hard in straight but could not   run down leader.
last_comments.SENSIBLE CHOICE: Jumped awkwardly, niggled along throughout, never           responded.
last_comments.COUP D'ETAT: Eased to sit in front of midfield, 4Ls off the leader on    the rails, suited by the fast pace, held up 4-2, closed off well when  clear.
last_comments.SKIP COURT: Very slow away, never a factor.
last_comments.WINNING TIME: Began fairly, then crowded and lost ground, settling last.  Lost contact with the field 400m and never competitive.
last_comments.SUNNY YING: Pushed forward from the jump to sit in a handy position, 1  off the fence. Prominently placed early in the straight,    but had a tendency to lay in, peaked at the 200m and faded  back.
last_comments.NAMJONG BLOSSOMS: Bumped start, recovered to race prominently, unbalanced     near 450M, folded up quickly after straightening, finished  tailed out.
last_comments.TAKE TO THE LIMIT: Taken back early to sit towards the rear of the field, 1    off the fence. Never fully ridden out in the straight, and  found to be lame in the off fore leg.
last_comments.BAAB AL NASR: Shifted across behind runners from wide draw, settling at   rear close to fence. Improved position around turn, shifted in abruptly 400m to get run and finished off nicely. Rider  dropped rein 200m.
last_comments.JUST WONDERFUL: Began well but unable find cover and raced wide back        stretch. Lost position around turn, and tired soon after    entering straight.
last_comments.SUN PINS: Began OK, settling three-back, one-off back stretch. Urged  forward between horses around turn but blocked for run in   straight until 200m. Finished off nicely.
last_comments.SIGHT BELIEVER: Got off nicely, racing close to outer fence 3L from leader. Raced in restricted room 700m but remained in contention    till final 200m when tired slightly.
last_comments.GOLDEN ADDICTION: Up with early pace, restrained to 6th place middle stages,  responded well leaving the bend to go 2nd 150M, proved no   match with winner, one paced final stages and lost 2nd near line.
last_comments.ALL MY BENEFIT: Broke well, raced 1 back on rail, under pump 560m,          struggled in tepid run home.
last_comments.MOBILE KING: Slow start & rousted to race fore of midfield on rail,      driven turning in, shifted 1 off, stayed on dourly to wire.
last_comments.EVERYONE'S FORTUNE: Dropped back at break, raced at rear throughout, never a    factor.
last_comments.EN CIVIL: Hard ridden to take rail and led by 0.5L, clocked fast      sectionals, reduced quickly 300M.
last_comments.LUCKY FOLLOW ME: Began awkwardly and settled at rear, one paced on straight.
last_comments.JUST ACE: Settled on pace, raced keenly and steadied passing 1000m,   under pressure home turn and the weakened in straight.
last_comments.MANIPULATION: Inconvenienced at start, settled midfield, impeded near     300m but had every chance thereafter.
last_comments.SOLAR DRAGON: Jumped well, got head up when steadied at 1100m,            inconvenienced at 1000m, traveled nicely near 600m, ridden  along to challenge home turn, brief chance at 300m but      weakened final 150m.
last_comments.ALWAYS SOMETHING: At rear, 7Ls off the leader 2-3 wide, benefited by the fast pace, progressed steadily 300M.
last_comments.BANGALORE: Bounded out of the gates, and sat at the rear of the field. Came widest from the 300m, but delivered nothing, and only  beat one home.
last_comments.NAUGHTY BABY: Crowded on jumping, and initially at the rear of the field  on the fence. Worked forward in early/mid stages to sit     midfield. Worked forward steadily from the turn, but never  a threat, and peaked 100m.
last_comments.ROCKET FLY: Taken back from the widest draw, raced at tail throughout,  only passed a few tired runners in straight, never a threat.
last_comments.WINNING APEX: Hard ridden early, 4Ls off the leader 2 wide, benefited by  the fast tempo, flattened in straight.
last_comments.OCEAN POWER: Crowded out and bumped start, ridden but failed to muster,  settling in midfield. Lost position back stretch when       others moved forward and found little in straight when      asked.
last_comments.NAVEL ORANGE: Began fairly, taken in but kept away from fence, settling   behind midfield in one-off position. Switched three-wide    around final turn to make challenge but only one-paced in   straight.
last_comments.SUNSHINE KID: Broke well & prominent until settled 1 back on rail,        bustled a touch 850m, ridden turning in, found nil & faded  right out.
last_comments.COSTA DEL SOL: Ridden along to hold 4th spot within 2L of pace, became     3-wide in 6th around home bend, failed to quicken under     pressure after straightening.
last_comments.POSITIVE ENERGY: Awkward start losing ground, trailed the field to straight, fought on steadily past well beaten horses.
last_comments.SING SING SING: Jumped well and sent forward, niggle at near 700m, hung in  badly and gave ground quickly, eased down final 150m.
last_comments.WINDICATOR STAR: Crowded out at start, dropping to rear but away from fence. Clear last around turn, taken wide in straight and ran on   fairly.
last_comments.REGENCY HO HO: In midfield early stages, shuffled back to 3rd last         approaching home turn, held up for clear running early      straight, failed to respond when ridden to chase leaders.   (Muco)
last_comments.FIONN'S TREASURE: Just off the pace tracking along the 2-path, stayed on      mildly to go 3rd near the line.
last_comments.FAY DEEP: Hard ridden to keep up at rear, 6Ls off the leaders, no     progress.
last_comments.MONEY CAFE: Smart break, raced 4th 1 off with cover, driven to lead     360m, all out & headed 280m, tapered thereafter.
last_comments.SILVER MISSION: Speed to lead but soon headed & sat rail in 3rd , shifted 1 off 420m but not clear run, shuffled back & lost several    lengths, found nil thereafter.
last_comments.BRILLANTE: Settled just off the lead, reduced 200M.
last_comments.GIDEON: Started OK, raced rail midfield, broke down & fell 850m.
last_comments.SUPER HORSE: Jumped fairly to be midfield early, gradually dropped back  far side to reach tail-end over 500 metres out, no further  impression.
last_comments.ELECTRONIC GOSPEL: Travelled wide just better than midfield early stages,      obtained cover in home straight the first time but          difficult to settle to slow pace at times, slightly worse   when pace quickened far side, found nothing in the run home.
last_comments.P J HALL: Bumped at start, settled on pace, under pressure home turn, steadied at 100m when weakening out of it.
last_comments.GLOBAL FAME: Settled worse than midfield, pushed along to improve near   500m, kept to rail in straight and finished off one paced.
last_comments.MY NAME IS BOND: Jumped well, pressed forward to hold second spot, 1L from   leader. Looked a chance top of straight but ran out of      stamina 200m and weakened. Lame right front leg.
last_comments.SUMARAND DRAGON: Broke ok to race on inner behind midfield, shaken up 350m,  outpaced in run home.
last_comments.ULTIMATE WINNERS: At rear throughout, never looked competitive.
last_comments.INCREDIBLE ACT: Tardy start, raced rail midfield, advanced a spot 650m,     bustled 500m & shifted out, faded in run home.
last_comments.GOOD FRIENDS MAGIC: Travelled keenly in midfield 3-wide, slightly wider turning in, found nothing in straight.
last_comments.BLACK STAR: Settled in midfield one off the rails, soon faded after     straightening.
last_comments.TRIUMPHANT WAY: Towards the rear, one-paced in straight.
last_comments.RISING FAST: Raced midfield, travelled 4Ls behind the leader 2 wide with cover, eased down soon after straightening.
last_comments.FOREVER GENKI: Away with them, raced 4 lengths or so back on rail at rear, last turning in, finished off one-paced.
last_comments.GOOD SMILE: Began well, raced 3 wide with no cover, a length behind the leader, same margin back on turn, weakened gradually in     straight.
last_comments.EYE ON YOU: Midfield, 4Ls off the leader, trapped 3 wide throughout,    harmed by the slow pace, never improved.
last_comments.MAZANDARAN: Ridden to hold forward position, settling one-back,         one-off. Niggled at around home turn to hold position, a    little wide into straight, boxed on gamely.
last_comments.COOL BEAN: Bumped start, ridden to get forward position but found a    few others faster and forced to race wide without cover at  midfield. Put under pressure 300m but found nothing and     faded.
last_comments.HAWTHORNE: Very awkward away, hard ridden to keep up in midfield, 4Ls  off the leader on the rails, not suited by the slow pace,   no turn of foot.
last_comments.SURE CHAMP: Began well, making use of good draw to settle three-back,   one-off. Travelled well to turn when put under pressure     without responding. Not tested latter stages of race.       Jockey reported not comfortable in action.
last_comments.TRACKER: Taken back from a wide gate, travelled 6.5Ls behind the     leader 2 wide with cover, not suited by the slow tempo,     never ran on.
last_comments.ISLAND GARDEN: Restrained, shifted across behind horses from wide draw and last on settling. Never competitive. Found to have          substantial blood in trachea.
last_comments.ELECTRONIC FORTUNE: Pressed forward, racing three-wide without cover outside    leading pair to turn. Lost position entering straight and   weakened gradually.
last_comments.SUPER DRAGON: Moderately away, raced 2 to 3 lengths back in midfield, 2   wide on turn, made some progress in straight to get 3rd, no threat to the first two.
last_comments.YOUNG HAPPY: Slow to begin and crowded shortly after, settle at rear,    commenced to improve passing 500m, bumped and unbalanced    when laying in near 250m.
last_comments.LAUDABLE VIRTUE: Crowded at start and settled towards rear, held up early    part of straight, commenced to make ground passing 300m,    crowded at 250m, finished off nicely.
last_comments.REAL SPECIALIST: Never far off 2.5Ls behind leader in a slowly run race,     sprinted home well from 350M, chased winner all the way to  line, held by diminishing neck.
last_comments.TWIN TURBO: Hard ridden from start but slow to muster and trapped wide  without cover in midfield around first turn. Allowed to     stride forward from 1000m to race outside lead from 800m to straight before tiring gradually.
last_comments.RIYADH: Began fairly but failed to stretch out and soon last.       Trailed field thereafter.
last_comments.MI SAVVY: Jumped well, positioned nicely in 2nd, same position on     turn, kept on well in straight to get 2nd, no threat to the winner.
last_comments.NO TIES: Taken back from wide gate at start, hard ridden near 500m,  one paced in straight.
last_comments.BOTH SURE: Behind midfield, 5Ls off the leaders on the rails, harmed   by the slow pace, little dash 100M.
last_comments.PRINCE OF SUNSHINE: Jumped well and settled behind leader, unable to quicken on straightening and battled to the line.
last_comments.SECRET IDENTITY: Jumped awkwardly and ridden along to settle on speed, under pressure from 800m and weakened out of it soon after.
last_comments.BEYOND FANTASY: Settled worse than midfield about 6Ls behind the leader on  the fence, never a factor, collapsed after the race.
last_comments.DOUBLE GLORY: Fractious in stalls, jumped awkwardly and lost significant  amount of ground, recovered along the fence to race within  range of the leaders to top of the straight before fading   away 250M.
last_comments.GIGGLES FOREVER: In front of midfield, 3.5Ls off the good pace on the rails, flattened 250M, on heels 200M.
last_comments.JUN JU: Eased back, 10Ls off the good pace along the fence, lack    room 250M, no turn of foot.
last_comments.BUNKER SHOT: Broke ok, bustled to settle 1 back on rail, shaken up       turning in but in pocket & checked 230m, switched 1 off,    kept on for 3rd but always held.
last_comments.RED COURAGE: Settled on pace, unable to improve home turn, battled to    line one paced.
last_comments.SICHUAN EXEC: Shaken up early to take up a forward position,  raced       keenly, in 4th making the turn for home, failed to find     extra when placed under pressure.
last_comments.TOMODACHI: Sharp start, caught 4 wide no cover 2L back, rolled on to   within 1L 500m, found nil in run home.
